cases.sentence: Вдруг произошло сильное землетрясение, потому что ___ Господа спустился с неба, подошел к гробнице и отвалил камень.
cases.translation: Suddenly there was a great earthquake, because an angel of the Lord came down from heaven, approached the tomb, and rolled away the stone.
cases.explain: Ангел is the subject of спустился (came down) — nominative.

cases.sentence: потому что ангел Господа спустился с ___, подошел к гробнице и отвалил камень.
cases.translation: ...because an angel of the Lord came down from heaven, approached the tomb, and rolled away the stone.
cases.explain: The preposition с meaning “down from” takes the genitive → неба.

cases.sentence: спустился с неба, подошел к ___ и отвалил камень.
cases.translation: ...came down from heaven, approached the tomb, and rolled away the stone.
cases.explain: The preposition к (toward) takes the dative → гробнице.

cases.translation: ...approached the tomb and rolled away the stone.
cases.explain: Отвалил (rolled away) takes a direct object; камень is inanimate, so the accusative matches the nominative: камень.

cases.sentence: Своим ___ он был, как молния, а его одежда была белой, как снег.
cases.translation: In his appearance he was like lightning, and his clothes were white as snow.
cases.explain: Instrumental of manner/comparison — “in his appearance” → видом (no preposition needed).

cases.sentence: Мне дана вся власть на ___ и на земле.
cases.translation: All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.
cases.explain: The preposition на indicating location (not motion) takes the prepositional → небе.

reading.ru: Его здесь нет, он воскрес, как и говорил ранее.
reading.question: What did the angel tell the women about Jesus?
options: He is not here; he has risen
He is still in the tomb
reading.correct: He is not here; he has risen
reading.explain: The angel said Jesus was not there, for he had risen, just as he had said.

reading.ru: Они подошли, обняли его ноги и поклонились ему.
reading.question: How did the women react when Jesus met them on the road?
options: They took hold of his feet and worshiped him
They asked him to prove who he was
reading.correct: They took hold of his feet and worshiped him
reading.explain: The women came, clasped his feet, and worshiped him.

reading.ru: Они дали солдатам много денег и сказали. Говорите всем так, его ученики пришли ночью и выкрали его, пока мы спали.
reading.question: What story did the chief priests pay the soldiers to spread?
options: That the disciples stole Jesus' body while the guards slept
That an earthquake destroyed the tomb
That the guards saw Jesus ascend to heaven
reading.correct: That the disciples stole Jesus' body while the guards slept
reading.explain: The priests bribed the soldiers to say the disciples came at night and stole the body while they slept.

reading.ru: Тогда, подойдя, Иисус сказал им, Мне дана вся власть на небе и на земле.
reading.question: What did Jesus say had been given to him?
options: All authority in heaven and on earth
reading.correct: All authority in heaven and on earth
reading.explain: Jesus said all authority in heaven and on earth had been given to him.

reading.ru: Крестите их во имя Отца, Сына и Святого Духа и учите их исполнять все, что я вам повелел.
reading.question: What did Jesus command his disciples to do to all nations?
options: Baptize them and teach them to obey everything he commanded
reading.correct: Baptize them and teach them to obey everything he commanded
reading.explain: Jesus commanded them to baptize all nations and teach them to obey all he had commanded.
